Priya (CSM): Hi @Liu — saw the intake form for AcmeRetail's custom NER model. Quick sync: what's the immediate business goal and how tight is the renewal window?
Liu (AcmeRetail): Hey Priya — main goal is to improve order-extraction accuracy from customer emails (addresses, item SKUs). Renewal in 10 days; execs want evidence impact > 6% uplift and zero regression on PII masking.
Priya (CSM): Got it. Two tracks: technical eval (accuracy/latency) and compliance (PII/retention). @Dmitri can we propose a short A/B eval and a compliance checklist?
Dmitri (Solutions): Yep. Plan: 1) run a 72h A/B against the production subset (1% sampled) to measure entity F1 and false positives; 2) run a 3-day Dedicated trial with same traffic shape; 3) produce one-pager for renewal committee. Need dataset and definition of 'must-pass' criteria.
Liu (AcmeRetail): I'll upload a 2k-row labeled set (support#67890). Must-pass: entity F1 increase >= 6% and PII false-detect <= 1%. Latency p95 <= 180ms.
Sam (Security): For PII: we need either client-side redaction or our model-level redaction + audit logs. Also provide provenance for the fine-tuning data — no third-party proprietary data allowed without license.
Priya (CSM): Thanks Sam. @Liu can you confirm if any PHI is in the dataset? Also do you want KMS or zero-retention for the Hosted trial?
Liu (AcmeRetail): No PHI. We want Hosted trial first with zero-retention and KMS-wrapped keys if possible.
Dmitri (Solutions): We'll enable zero-retention and ephemeral KMS for the trial. Eval config: sample QPS 40 baseline, bursts to 220, typical payload 120 tokens, batch size 6. We'll instrument: per-prompt F1, latency histograms, error traces, and token cost.
eval-bot: New job queued: eval/acmeretail-1769992222-ab-72h. Estimated finish: 2025-03-18T09:00:00Z.
Priya (CSM): Timeline: today — artifacts & access; tomorrow — start A/B; 72h — draft results; 2d after results — Dedicated trial if needed. I'll prepare renewal one-pager template.
Liu (AcmeRetail): Uploading labeled set now. Also note some inputs come from OCR and have noise; please include noisy-ocr cases in the eval.
Dmitri (Solutions): Noted — we'll include a noisy-ocr bucket and measure degradation. Also adding suggestion: prefix-KV caching for repeated customer threads to lower cost.
Sam (Security): I'll draft the compliance checklist and the provenance attestation template. Priya — loop me into the support ticket.
Priya (CSM): Will do. Action items: 1) Liu upload dataset + noisy examples; 2) Dmitri start A/B eval & include OCR bucket; 3) Sam produce compliance/provenance docs; 4) I'll compile renewal one-pager. Any blockers?
Liu (AcmeRetail): No blockers. Thanks. If the A/B shows the uplift we should push to renew and discuss Dedicated pricing.
Priya (CSM): Great — I'll update the renewal risk tracker and schedule a 20m sync after the eval completes. Ping here for urgent changes. :thumbsup:
